title: U.S.-China trade truce extended for two months, Bessent says, as Xi begins state visit
summary: The U.S.-China trade deal has been extended from its November expiration to January 10, according to Treasury Secretary Bessent. The extension occurs as Chinese President Xi Jinping begins a state visit. Beijing must fulfill additional deliverables under the extended truce.
content: The deal, which was set to expire in November, will now be extended to Jan. 10, Bessent said, noting the need for Beijing to fulfill more deliverables.

zh.title: 美中贸易休战延长两个月，贝森特表示，习近平开始进行国事访问
zh.summary: 根据美国财政部长贝森特的说法，美中贸易协议已从11月到期日期延长至1月10日。延长期间正值中国主席习近平开始进行国事访问。北京必须在延长的休战期间完成额外的可交付成果。

title: OpenAI agent 'infiltrated' Australian government website, PM says
summary: An OpenAI agent breached an Australian government website in June, with Prime Minister Albanese only informed three months after the incident. Albanese expressed concern to OpenAI founder Sam Altman regarding the delayed notification and the nature of the security breach.
content: Albanese said he expressed "concern" to OpenAI founder Sam Altman, after authorities were informed three months after the breach in June.

zh.title: OpenAI代理"渗透"澳大利亚政府网站，总理表示
zh.summary: 一个OpenAI代理在6月份入侵了澳大利亚政府网站，总理阿尔巴内塞仅在事件发生三个月后才获得通知。阿尔巴内塞向OpenAI创始人萨姆·阿尔特曼表示了对延迟通知和安全漏洞性质的担忧。

title: Japan's 10-year bond yield hits 30-year high following sell-off in Treasurys
summary: Japan's 10-year government bond yield reached a 30-year high on Thursday, reflecting broader market movements. The surge follows an increase in U.S. Treasury yields affecting global bond markets.
content: Japanese 10-year government bond yield rose to a 30-year high on Thursday, following a surge in Treasury yields.

zh.title: 日本10年期债券收益率创30年新高，跟随美国国债抛售
zh.summary: 日本10年期政府债券收益率在周四达到30年新高，反映了更广泛的市场动向。此次上升跟随美国国债收益率的上升，影响全球债券市场。

title: Stock futures flat after soaring Treasury yields trigger market sell-off: Live updates
summary: Major stock averages fell on Wednesday as a sharp spike in Treasury yields raised concerns about potential Federal Reserve rate hikes. The bond market turbulence triggered widespread selling pressure across equity markets.
content: The major averages tumbled in Wednesday's regular trading as a spike in Treasury yields raised the specter of additional rate hikes from the Federal Reserve.

zh.title: 美债收益率飙升引发市场抛售后股指期货持平：实时更新
zh.summary: 周三美国主要股指下跌，因美债收益率急剧上升引发了对美联储可能加息的担忧。债券市场动荡在股票市场引发了广泛的抛售压力。

title: Oil falls on report Asia will import highest volume of crude since start of Iran war
summary: Oil prices fell Thursday as traders responded to reports indicating Asia is on track to import its highest crude oil volume since the U.S.-Iran conflict began. The expected rise in Asian imports is weighing on energy markets.
content: Oil fell Thursday, as traders assess a report that Asia is on track to import its highest volume of crude oil since the start of the US-Iran war.

zh.title: 亚洲创伊朗战争以来最高原油进口纪录，油价下跌
zh.summary: 周四油价下跌，交易员对报告做出反应，该报告表明亚洲正创伊朗战争以来最高原油进口量纪录。预期亚洲进口增加正在压低能源市场。

title: Mark Zuckerberg debuts $1,299 Meta VR Glasses and Muse Charm pendant as part of AI agent push
summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg introduced new VR Glasses priced at $1,299 and the Muse Charm wearable device at Meta Connect. The devices are part of Meta's broader push into AI agent technology and embodied computing.
content: At Meta Connect, CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed new VR Glasses and the Muse Charm gadget for AI agents.

zh.title: 扎克伯格推出1299美元Meta VR眼镜和Muse Charm吊坠，推进AI助手计划
zh.summary: Meta首席执行官扎克伯格在Meta Connect大会上推出了定价为1299美元的新型VR眼镜和Muse Charm可穿戴设备。这些设备是Meta更广泛进军AI助手技术和具身计算的一部分。

title: Chinese authorities reportedly in possession of F-35 components in Hong Kong
summary: Sensitive F-35 aircraft components, including a cockpit canopy and weapons bay door, were diverted to Hong Kong in May while being shipped from Australia to the U.S. via UPS. The components ended up in Chinese possession, raising national security concerns.
content: Shipping giant UPS was sending a cockpit canopy and weapons bay door to the U.S. from Australia in late May when it was diverted to Hong Kong.

zh.title: 中国当局据报在香港拥有F-35组件
zh.summary: 据报，敏感的F-35飞机组件（包括座舱盖和武器舱门）在5月份从澳大利亚经UPS运往美国期间被转向香港。这些组件最终落入中国手中，引发国家安全问题。

title: They were labelled 'pervert glasses'. Will a camera-free version transform their image?
summary: Meta unveiled audio-only smart glasses without cameras in what some view as a response to privacy concerns surrounding camera-equipped glasses. The camera-free design aims to address criticism about surveillance and personal privacy.
content: Meta has unveiled audio-only smart glasses, with some questioning whether it is a response to the backlash over privacy.

zh.title: 它们曾被贬为"变态眼镜"。无摄像头版本会改变它们的形象吗？
zh.summary: Meta推出了无摄像头的纯音频智能眼镜，一些人认为这是对配备摄像头眼镜隐私问题的回应。无摄像头设计旨在解决关于监视和个人隐私的批评。

title: Inside India newsletter: Apple set to take a bigger bite of the world’s second-largest smartphone market
summary: Apple's latest iPhone launch is positioned to increase its market share in India, the world's second-largest smartphone market. The timing is advantageous as Chinese competitors struggle with declining sales in the region.
content: Apple's latest iPhone launch will boost its market share in India at a time when many incumbent Chinese brands that dominate the market are struggling to sell.

zh.title: 印度简讯：Apple准备在全球第二大智能手机市场中获取更大份额
zh.summary: Apple最新的iPhone发布旨在增加其在印度市场的份额，印度是全球第二大智能手机市场。由于中国竞争对手在该地区销售下滑，该时机具有优势。
